items.desc: Introduction Are you interested in the communication networks behind modern AI systems? Would you like to combine mathematical modeling with experiments on programmable network hardware to make AI infrastructure faster and more energy-efficient? In this PhD project, you will develop models and orchestration methods for the networks that connect GPUs during large language model inference. Are you our next PhD candidate in high-performance AI networking? Job Description Your research challenge Large language models rely on powerful computing infrastructure to generate responses. When inference […] requirements, complemented by energy estimates based on measurement-calibrated power models. Building on these models, you will explore how architectural choices—including network topology, link bandwidth, and parallelization strategies—affect performance and energy consumption. You will develop tools that help cluster designers evaluate promising configurations efficiently. You will also investigate how the models can guide runtime decisions, such as workload placement, prioritization, routing, or resource reservation. A focused prototype will demonstrate how model-informed decisions can improve the operation of an existing network. Experimental validation will be an integral part of your research. Le premier est relié à l'information quantique dans les paires de quarks top: le quark top se désintégrant avant de s’hadroniser, une paire tt¯ se comporte comme un système à deux qubits dont la matrice de densité de spin peut être mesurée.
